threads.body: The new flag name/property key uses "filed" (typo) instead of "field". Since this is a user-configurable system property and a constant identifier, keeping the typo will be confusing and makes the feature harder to discover/configure correctly.

The system property name includes "check-virtual-filed-usage" (typo). If you rename it to "field" in VirtualFieldChecker, this argument also needs to be updated so tests actually enable the intended flag and the property name remains consistent/guessable.
